data.one_liner: iOS RoomPlan plugin for single/multi-room scans, 2D plans and 3D models.
data.what_it_does: It is an iOS-only Flutter plugin that integrates Apple's RoomPlan framework to scan single or connected rooms. It captures room geometry, exports 2D floor-plan PDFs and 3D USDZ models, and exposes structured scan data.
use_when: You need to scan rooms and generate 2D floor-plan PDFs or 3D USDZ models on iOS.
Your target iOS devices feature a LiDAR scanner and support RoomPlan.
avoid_when: You need support for Android, web, or desktop platforms.
Target devices do not have a LiDAR scanner or run iOS versions prior to 16.
strengths: Enables native Apple RoomPlan single and multi-room scanning in Flutter.
Exports both 2D PDFs and 3D USDZ models along with structured scan data.
Includes built-in scanning pages, model viewers, file sharing, and persistent scan libraries.
weaknesses: Restricted to iOS only due to native RoomPlan framework requirements.
Requires physical devices with LiDAR hardware (such as iPhone Pro or iPad Pro models); does not work in the simulator.
data.setup_notes: Requires setting the iOS deployment target to 16.0 or later and adding a camera usage description (NSCameraUsageDescription) to Info.plist.
